definitions.accuracy: fraction of the graded items that are correct: the reported value, rounded to the precision the task asks for, equals the reference, or its relative error is below the tolerance; non-numeric items must match exactly; an item the answer does not report is wrong
definitions.answer_rate: fraction of the graded items for which the answer reports a usable value, right or wrong
definitions.mean_relative_error: mean of |reported - reference| / |reference| over the run's numeric items that have one; a zero reference has none, and an unreported value counts as settings.scoring.missing_relative_error
definitions.median_relative_error: median of the same relative errors
definitions.elapsed_seconds: wall-clock time of the agent's turn, from its manifest.json
definitions.llm_seconds: summed duration of the turn's language-model calls, from prompts/
definitions.non_llm_seconds: elapsed_seconds minus llm_seconds: code execution, data loading and everything else
definitions.llm_calls: number of language-model calls in the turn
definitions.code_attempts: code blocks executed, compute and visualization stages together; one per stage means no repair was needed
definitions.llm_input_chars: characters sent to the model over all calls; the agent does not record token counts, so characters stand in for them
definitions.llm_output_chars: characters the model returned over all calls
definitions.per_task: every metric as mean and sample standard deviation (n - 1) over the task's runs, n being the runs counted; std is null for a single run. Scores count every run whose answer could be read (a run without an answer scores 0); efficiency counts the runs whose turn completed, i.e. wrote a manifest
definitions.repeats: the k-th run of every task, in chronological order, forms repeat k, as the batch runner replays the whole case folder; only repeats that every task has are formed. Each value is the mean over the repeat's tasks
definitions.summary: every metric as the mean over tasks of the per-task means, and its sample standard deviation across repeats (null with fewer than two); totals sum the efficiency of every completed run
definitions.by_difficulty: for each difficulty level of settings.difficulty_levels, answer rate and accuracy as the mean over the level's scored tasks of the per-task means, and the sample standard deviation across repeats of the level's per-repeat means; tasks of the level without a run are listed as missing
